ui.hero: Custom applications and AI integrations for your business
ui.intro: I help businesses improve their processes with web applications and AI grounded in their own data. I combine Laravel and React experience with machine learning and clear communication.
ui.contactText: Email igor@jozefowicz.pl with the problem, your current tools, the result you need and your timeline. Scope, pricing and ongoing maintenance are agreed individually.
ui.bioText: I have been programming since 2018. My experience includes PHP and Laravel web applications, React development and machine learning projects. I have worked on projects at Matysart and taught programming at Coding Giants. Teaching AI, Python and other technologies helps me explain technical choices clearly.
steps: Discovery — understand the problem and desired outcome.
Scope — select features and define how to evaluate the solution.
Prototype — test key assumptions with a small working example.
Delivery — integrate the solution and hand it over to users.

services.title: Custom applications
services.intro: When spreadsheets, email and disconnected tools get in the way, a dedicated application can bring processes and information together.
items: Internal tools for managing data and workflows.
Customer portals for information access and service requests.
Integrations that reduce manual transfer of data between existing systems.
A project can include discovery, web development, integrations, testing and delivery. We first check whether an existing tool would meet your needs.

services.title: AI integrations
services.intro: AI can help employees find information and handle repetitive tasks when it has suitable data and its output is evaluated.
items: Assistants grounded in company documents and knowledge.
Information retrieval with references to source material.
Support for classification and repetitive content tasks with human review.

RAG retrieves relevant company information and gives it to a model as context. It does not guarantee accuracy: source references, access permissions and missing-information handling still need evaluation.
A project can include data preparation, a prototype, application integration and quality evaluation. Model usage and maintenance costs are discussed separately.

projects.title: Vento
paragraphs: Support an online catalogue and sales of heating and ventilation solutions.
A business application and online shop for a heating and ventilation company.
Programming work on the web application and online shop.
A Laravel application with a database, React interface development, payment and search integrations.
Delivered capabilities include product presentation, shop functionality, payment and search integrations.
projects.technologies: Laravel, MySQL, React, Sass, Przelewy24, Algolia

projects.title: Forcen
paragraphs: Present company services and support answers to questions.
Website development and chatbot integration using a language model API and company-data context.
A RAG integration retrieves company material and provides it as context for responses.
The work covered integrating a language model with company data within a web application.
projects.technologies: Laravel, React, Tailwind, LLM API, RAG

projects.title: LarynxAI
paragraphs: Explore image classification in a project concerning laryngeal pathology.
A team machine learning project concerning laryngeal images.
My contribution focused on the classifier; dataset management and image tagging belong to the wider team system.
Work with images, deep learning models and classification evaluation tools.
Work on an image classifier as a component of the wider team system.
projects.technologies: Python, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, NumPy, scikit-learn, FastAPI
